description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for the 'categories' table within a Flutter/Dart project. It provides methods for inserting, updating, deleting, and querying category records in an SQLite database, utilizing the sqflite package. The class 'CategoryDao' interacts with a 'DatabaseHelper' to perform database operations and manages Category model instances.

classes.name: CategoryDao
classes.description: Data access object for manipulating categories in the database, providing CRUD operations.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new category into the database. Throws an error if a category with the same name exists (due to UNIQUE constraint).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing category identified by its id. Throws an error if the category's id is null.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category by id, but only if it is not referenced by any transactions. Throws an error if the category is referenced.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all categories ordered by name.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Finds a category by its id, returns null if not found.
